scenarios.task: Tie rebar cages for a new below-grade utility vault along the Rhine-side promenade walkway.
steps: Attend the daily huddle and confirm the lift plan with the operator.
Inspect rebar caps and place them on all exposed vertical ends.
Set your work zone with barricades to separate the walkway from the deck.
Tie cage corners first, then interior ties, checking spacing against the drawing.
Use a tag line to control the cage during the crane set.
Step clear and give the all-clear signal before the crane releases.
Check tied cage for loose bars and secure or re-tie as needed.

rubric.pass_if: Caps or troughs on every exposed end before work begins
Standard hand signals used and no one under suspended load
Ties tight, spacing within tolerance, no loose bars left
Walkway barricaded and pedestrians rerouted before first lift

scenarios.robot_role: Tows bundled rebar from the laydown area to the vault edge, keeping hands away from manual carrying on the congested walkway.

scenarios.task: Pull feeder circuits through existing conduit to a new lab equipment panel inside an occupied research building.
steps: Pull the permit and verify lockout/tagout on the target panel.
Confirm zero-energy with a tested meter before opening any cover.
Deburr and ream conduit ends before starting the pull.
Set up the pull with proper grips and a steady two-person rhythm.
Terminate at the panel following the print torqued to spec.
Label both ends and update the as-built drawing.
Restore power only after inspection sign-off and remove your locks.

rubric.pass_if: Lock applied, meter tested on known source before and after verification
Reaming done, no wire damage observed after pull
Torque marks present and lugs labeled
As-built updated and panel schedule legible

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds cable off the reel at a controlled tension so apprentices keep hands clear of the conduit mouth.

scenarios.task: Replace a corroded steam condensate line segment in a campus utility tunnel beneath the production buildings.
steps: Retrieve the confined space permit and log entry with the attendant.
Test the tunnel atmosphere top-down before entry.
Isolate and lock out the steam line, then verify cooldown by temperature check.
Set ventilation running and monitor continuously during the work.
Cut out the corroded segment and prep both pipe ends.
Fit and weld the replacement spool, then pressure-test per procedure.
Log exit, restore isolations and close the permit.

rubric.pass_if: Four-gas readings within limits before entry and monitored throughout
Steam locked out, tagged, and cooldown verified before cutting
Attendant posted, retrieval line rigged, entry/exit logged
Pressure test held with no leaks at rated pressure

scenarios.robot_role: Carries the gas monitor through the tunnel ahead of entry for a remote pre-check of the atmosphere.

scenarios.task: Set insulated glass units into an aluminum curtain-wall frame on a riverside facade above a public esplanade.
hazards: Glass fall from height onto public walk
ppe: Full-body harness tied to anchor points
steps: Check the wind forecast and stop work if gusts exceed the site limit for glazing.
Rig the exclusion zone and sidewalk closure below the pick.
Inspect the vacuum lifter seals on the ground before the lift.
Set the unit with the crane, guiding with tag lines only.
Insert setting blocks, square the unit and drive the pressure plates.
Torque all fasteners and apply the weather seal.
Remove the exclusion zone only after debris sweep and inspection.

rubric.pass_if: Exclusion zone established and signposted before the first lift
Vacuum lifter seals inspected and function-tested on record
Work paused when wind exceeds the limit
Setting blocks placed, seal continuous, fasteners torqued

scenarios.task: Confined drain-line cleanout after a reported solvent spill in a lab waste line serving the research wing.
ppe: Full-face respirator with organic vapor cartridges
steps: Review the safety data sheets and confirm the spilled solvent identity.
Set exclusion zone and notify the building lab safety officer.
Verify respirator fit test is current and don PPE with a buddy check.
Test pit atmosphere before entry and ventilate continuously.
Pump and containerize waste, labeling each drum for disposal.
Decontaminate tools and personnel through the wash station.
Complete the hazardous waste manifest with the disposal coordinator.

rubric.pass_if: SDS reviewed and solvent identity confirmed before PPE selection
Fit-tested respirator donned with recorded buddy check
All waste containerized, labeled and manifested
Full decon sequence performed before doffing

scenarios.robot_role: Enters the pit first with gas sensors and a camera so the crew sizes up atmosphere and standing liquid without exposure.

scenarios.task: Install rooftop photovoltaic modules on a flat roof of an administrative building over occupied offices.
scenarios.hazards_note: Roof edge has no parapet on the river side.
steps: Stage materials away from the roof edge and mark the warning line.
Set anchor points and rig restraint systems before approaching edges.
Lay ballasted racking per the engineered layout, sealing every penetration.
Torque modules to spec and connect strings, keeping each string open until commissioning.
Verify polarity of each string with the meter before tie-in.
Torque-check a sample of fasteners and walk the array for damage.
Housekeeping pass: remove all scrap and coil leads off walk paths.

rubric.pass_if: Restraint system rigged before any work outside the warning line
Strings verified open and polarity checked before any tie-in
Ballast and module placement matches the engineered drawing
Roof clear of scrap and leads secured

scenarios.task: Lift an air-handling unit across the inner courtyard to a rooftop mechanical pit between occupied lab wings.
hazards: Power line proximity at courtyard edge
Load swing from building wind tunneling
steps: Walk the lift plan, confirm load weight and crane capacity chart.
Check exclusion zones over the courtyard entrances and post spotters.
Verify ground bearing and matting under outriggers.
Inspect rigging hardware and slings against the load chart.
Complete a trial lift a few centimeters and check balance.
Execute the pick on radio, one voice directing the operator.
Land and secure the unit before releasing the rigging.

rubric.pass_if: Weight verified, chart checked, plan signed before setup
No personnel under the load path at any time
All slings and hardware inspected, defects tagged out
Single designated signal person and clear radio protocol

scenarios.robot_role: Carries the load chart and inspection checklist between outrigger points so the crew chief verifies setup hands-free.
